title: Specification for Polyethylene Material for Moulding and Extrusion ( Third Revision )
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard prescribes the requirements and the methods of sampling and test for high density polyethylene (HDPE) materials for moulding and extrusion. It applies to materials ready for normal use in the form of powder, granules, and to materials unmodified by colourants, additives, films, etc. 1.2 This standard docs not cover masterbatches.
